alt: Chart of wall time per test case against CPU work per case: at 8 CPUs wall time equals the work up to 28 s, while at 4 CPUs wall time is double, 12 s of work takes 24 s, and 16 s or more passes the 30 s limit and times out.
caption: With 4 grader CPUs each of 8 simultaneous cases gets half a CPU, so any case needing more than about 15 s of computing times out and voids the submission.
